meta.text: Finally, the roadmap so you know what's coming. Four checkpoints, two worked cost-estimation problems where we actually estimate a bill before running anything, and a hands-on cluster sizing simulator where you'll drag worker counts and watch latency and cost move in opposite directions. And the preview of cost-aware practices: right-sizing from Spark UI metrics, job clusters for scheduled work, spot instances for fault-tolerant batch, and instance pools to cut start-up time. Let's begin with the engine lever.
